svg.aria-label: Keyboard one: C4 + E4, a major third, 4 semitones, three letters, in the major third colour #AB812D. Keyboard two: E4 + G4, a minor third, 3 semitones, three letters, in the minor third colour #8964A4.
svg.title: Same letters, different size: major and minor third

g.text: How to read this graphic: The coloured bracket under each keyboard names the pair. The
bar on the badge uses the same colour as the keys, because the colour belongs to the
pair of notes. The two colours differ because the semitone counts differ, even though
